caseName: Secretary of Commerce v. Kokechik Fishermen's Ass'n
caseNameFull: Secretary of Commerce v. Kokechik Fishermen's Assn. and Federation of Japanese Salmon Fisheries Cooperative Assn. v. Kokechik Fishermen's Assn.

opinions.text: Applications for stay of mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit and for stay of preliminary injunction of the United States District Court for the District of Columbia, presented to The Chief Justice, and by him referred to the Court, denied.
